english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone actively persuades another person or changes their mind through reasons or arguments.
This is the all-purpose choice when you successfully convince someone through reasons or verbal argument.
Use this when influencing someone means persuading or inducing them to agree or act.
Use this when “selling” a viewpoint means persuading someone to accept it.

examples.english: He used reason to convince me.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 dou6 lei5 seoi3 fuk6 zo2 ngo5

examples.english: I finally managed to persuade him to accept this plan.
examples.traditional: 我終於說服咗佢接受呢個方案。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 seoi3 fuk6 zo2 keoi5 zip3 sau6 ni1 go3 fong1 on3

examples.english: My friend finally managed to influence me to join the trip.
examples.traditional: 我個朋友終於說服我一齊去旅行。
